trait_realm_01_qi_info: Entry into cultivation, sensing Qi into the body.
trait_realm_02_foundation_info: Solidifying the Dao base, clearing the meridians.
trait_realm_03_core_info: Condensing the Golden Core, spiritual power takes shape.
trait_realm_04_nascent_info: Soul exits the shell, divine sense expands greatly.
trait_realm_05_deity_info: Spirit roams the void, magical power transforms.
trait_realm_06_infantchg_info: Reshaping the soul body, taking a step further.
trait_realm_07_wending_info: Peak of asking the Dao, glimpse the ultimate realm.
trait_realm_08_kuinie_info: Observing the gate of Nirvana, mind begins to settle.
trait_realm_09_jingnie_info: Nirvana fire cleanses the body, pure and flawless.
trait_realm_10_suinie_info: Break and stand, reborn through Nirvana.
trait_realm_11_kongnie_info: Insight into emptiness, Nirvana becomes formless.
trait_realm_12_kongling_info: Spirit platform is clear, merging with the Dao.
trait_realm_13_kongxuan_info: Mysterious and profound, the gateway to all wonders.
trait_realm_14_gtianzun_info: Supreme Empyrean status, dominating all realms.
trait_realm_15_half_tatian_info: Above Empyrean, like a chasm, beginning to walk the 9 Bridges.
trait_attr_01_metal_info: Metal is solemn and killing, sharp and solid.
trait_attr_02_wood_info: Wood is growth, extending and long.
trait_attr_03_water_info: Water nourishes downwards, merging and soft.
trait_attr_04_fire_info: Fire flames upwards, fierce and bright.
trait_attr_05_earth_info: Earth carries weight, transforming and completing.
trait_path_01_demonic_info: Proving Dao through demons, acting against the current.
trait_path_03_beast_info: Body of a beast, merging with heaven and earth.
trait_path_04_ancient_info: Inheriting Ancient God Dao, casting an indestructible body.
trait_intent_02_angel_info: Angel (Guardian): Range 10 Group Heal + Higher DMG reduction with more allies.
trait_intent_03_qianhuan_info: Illusions: Combat start, hit stacks +5% DMG (≤5, lasts 5s), Base Accuracy +15%.
trait_intent_04_killing_info: Bloodlust: +10% Final DMG at combat start; Kills add stacks, -1 stack/sec after 10s out of combat.
trait_intent_05_reverse_info: Reversal: Clear 1 debuff every 5s & gain +20% ATK for 5s.
trait_intent_06_life_death_info: Life/Death: Passive +20% Max HP; Combat phase 40% DMG Reduc + 30% Vamp.
trait_intent_07_reincarnation_info: Lifeguard: Passive death prevention, heal & invincible. 300yr CD.
trait_intent_08_chaos_info: Chaos: Combat start, 15% chance for 300% DMG or Self-Heal 10%.
trait_intent_01_extreme_info: Instantly execute same/lower realm on hit (Cannot reach Soul Formation in this life).
trait_divine_02_weiya_info: If enemy cultivator (ineffective vs Ancient Gods) is lower realm by 1 stage, they are immobilized.
trait_divine_01_baonuzhibian_info: Instantly heal 60% HP, +150% ATK for 60s; Costs 150 lifespan per use.
trait_divine_04_wanjianguizong_info: Summon flying sword storm, causes bleeding.
trait_divine_06_zhenkongquan_info: Release 6 tiles forward, causes damage & knockback 2 tiles, slows.
trait_divine_07_jiuyinbaiguzhao_info: Melee instant claw, executes 15% HP and prevents healing.
trait_divine_09_jianzhan_info: Summon an Immortal Sword from the heavens for a slash.
trait_art_01_missile_info: Refines vengeful souls. Hits prevent healing and deal extreme Dark burst damage.
trait_art_02_ascension_info: Burns Vital Energy to force cultivation rise. Vastly buffs ATK, DEF, Regen. Stuns/Scares lower realm enemies on cast.
trait_art_03_slash_info: Turns into afterimages for high-speed AOE slashes. Untargetable/Invincible during cast. Converts damage dealt to HP.
trait_art_04_quake_info: Infuses energy to cause a massive quake. Stuns ground units and deals devastating damage to buildings.
trait_art_05_waves_info: Summons black waves of demonic power forward. Each wave knocks back enemies and deals increasing damage.
trait_art_06_convert_info: Life/Death conversion. Deals burst damage to enemy, then instantly heals self and allies for that amount, cleansing debuffs.
trait_art_07_palm_info: Golden giant palm falls from sky. Suppresses area enemies (immobilize), destroys projectiles, deals True Damage.
trait_art_08_breaker_info: Condensed point of energy. Pierces armor. If target is a cultivator, disorders their Qi, greatly reducing all stats.
trait_art_09_shield_info: Visible energy shield. Greatly reduces incoming damage, reflects melee attacks, grants immunity to knockback/control.
trait_art_10_link_info: Links divine souls. Shares damage received. Blessings and misfortunes shared, live and die together.
trait_test_lingli_5000_info: Instantly gain 5000 Spiritual Energy, then trait removes itself.
trait_test_lingli_10000_info: Instantly gain 10000 Spiritual Energy, then trait removes itself.
trait_test_yuanli_5000_info: Instantly gain 5000 Origin Energy, then trait removes itself.
trait_test_yuanli_10000_info: Instantly gain 10000 Origin Energy, then trait removes itself.
trait_test_nieli_5000_info: Instantly gain 5000 Nirvana Energy, then trait removes itself.
trait_test_nieli_10000_info: Instantly gain 10000 Nirvana Energy, then trait removes itself.
trait_test_heaven_trial_info: Sets cultivator to 'Ascendant', maxes cultivation, pauses logic, resets cooldowns. Next job tick triggers Heavenly Trial.
row_possession_taken_info: Shows if this unit has been possessed.
row_tianyun_count_info: Accumulated times this unit was affected by Heavenly Fate (Reward or Backlash).
row_reinc_count_info: Shows reincarnation count and past life info.
row_previous_life_info: Shows original identity before possession (Click for details).
row_tianjiu_bridge_info: Current progress on the 9 Bridges of Trampling Heaven. Passing the 9th bridge advances to Trampling Heaven.
tab_mentorship_description: Shows Grandmaster, Master, Fellow Disciples, Apprentices.
row_next_break_req_info: Calculated by path: Cultivators show Cultivation Gap; Ancient Gods show Power Gap; Beasts show Demonic Power Gap. Shows 'Ready' if met, 'Peak' if maxed.
xn_treasure_hunfan_description: Ancient tool that uses souls as a banner to suppress spirits.
xn_treasure_qingtong_jian_description: Ancient bronze sword, sharp but unassuming.
xn_treasure_zijin_hulu_description: Can contain all things. Reveal power after refining.
xn_treasure_pangu_fu_description: Mountain-splitting tool, heavy as the ocean.
xn_treasure_qingguang_dun_description: Protects with clear light against edges and spells.
xn_treasure_tianni_zhu_description: Bead that defies heavenly secrets. Void Class.
xn_treasure_xianyu_baota_description: Exquisite pagoda, seals layer by layer. Void Class.
xn_treasure_mieshen_mao_description: Spear that breaks gods and souls. Void Class.
xn_treasure_liguang_gong_description: Bow opens like a full moon, arrows like meteors. Void Class.
xn_treasure_xiuxing_zhixin_description: Heart of a star, nurturing all things. Void Class.
xn_treasure_desc_hunfan: Treasure of the Soul Refining Sect. Contains a billion vengeful souls. Waving it causes wailing ghosts to cover the sun. Consumes living souls to grow, corrupts enemy treasures. A demonic weapon of the stars.
xn_treasure_desc_qingtong_jian: A simple ancient bronze sword, rusty but unmatched in sharpness. Engraved with ancient runes, it can break restrictions and teleport to kill enemies.
xn_treasure_desc_zijin_hulu: Purple Gold Gourd with strange powers, containing a universe inside. Can collect all living things and refine spiritual energy into pills.
xn_treasure_desc_pangu_fu: Heavy treasure of ultimate strength. One swing splits mountains, creating shockwaves. Usable only by those with immense physical strength.
xn_treasure_desc_qingguang_dun: Defensive treasure emitting azure light. When activated, creates an indestructible light curtain blocking attacks from all sides.
xn_treasure_desc_tianni_zhu: Item of defying fate, containing a space of five elements and time dilation. The starting point of the heaven-defying path and key to Trampling Heaven.
xn_treasure_desc_xianyu_baota: Pagoda made of supreme Immortal Jade. Multiple layers to suppress strong enemies or protect the user from heavy blows.
xn_treasure_desc_mieshen_mao: Companion weapon of the Ancient Gods, holding their wrath. One thrust shatters the starry sky, specialized in breaking Primordial Spirits and bodies.
xn_treasure_desc_liguang_gong: Legendary bow of Li Guang. Requires immense physical strength to draw. Arrows fly like dragons, never returning without blood. A weapon for long-range killing.
xn_treasure_desc_xiuxing_zhixin: Core of a Cultivation Planet. Only Step 2 cultivators can refine it. Merging with it allows controlling the planet's power to suppress enemies.
btn_xn_aura_toggle_desc: Show aura values on city/nation labels. Cities show single value, Nations show sum of all cities.
btn_xn_aura_add_brush_desc: Click city to randomly increase/decrease aura.
btn_xn_xiuzhenguo_toggle_desc: Show Cultivation Kingdom Level on labels. Level is based on number of cultivators, providing speed buffs and occupation limits.
btn_xn_place_ruins_desc: Place a Ruin at cursor location.
btn_xn_manual_gc_desc: Click if lagging. Also clears log.
ranking_legend_desc: L-Click: Generate/View; R-Click: Regenerate (Needs Custom API Key)
btn_xn_search_units_desc: Search units by name (Config in Mod Settings)
row_xn_kingdom_cultivation_level_info: Level based on cultivator realms. Affects cultivation speed and conquest limits.
row_xn_kingdom_aura_sum_info: Sum of aura in all cities.
row_xn_kingdom_ancients_info: Distribution of Ancient Gods in Kingdom
tip_xn_ambition: Current ambition of Tian Yunzi. Chance to spawn clones; at 10k, Tian Yunzi descends to slaughter.
btn_xn_add_ambition_desc: Adds value to 'Ambition' based on config. Input 0 to clear.
xn_config_enable_log Description: Controls output of Xian Ni mod logs/hints.
xn_config_city_aura_max Description: Random max cap for city aura. Positive int. Default 10000.
xn_config_enable_animation Description: Play cultivation effects/animations. Close to save performance.
xn_config_enable_tianyunzi_spawn Descrip: If off, Tian Yunzi/Clones wont spawn.
xn_config_enable_xiuzhenguo_suppress Des: If off, reverts to default conquest rules.
xn_config_enable_auto_join_army Descript: If on, high realm units (from Qi Condensation up) auto-join army.
xn_config_enable_building_protection Des: If on, buildings (except Ruins) cannot be destroyed. Ruins can always be manually destroyed.
xn_config_enable_demonic_hunt Descriptio: If on, Demonic Cultivators trigger NSFW content.
xn_config_enable_bloodline_awaken Descri: If on, high realm units can awaken as Progenitors. Off = No awakening.
xn_config_enable_mentorship Description: If on, cultivators can take apprentices.
xn_config_enable_xiuzhenguo_aura_limit D: If on, limits total aura. Recommended ON for balance.
xn_config_disable_condense Description: If on, stops auto-generation of Spirit Roots/Inheritance/Beast Paths.
xn_config_enable_broadcast_display Descr: On = Show on screen. Off = Hide (Logs still saved).
xn_config_enable_broadcast_console_log D: On = Write broadcasts to console with periodic cleanup. Off = No console logs, no 5-min cleanup.
xn_config_enable_mc_select_sfx Descripti: Plays audio companion. Don't use with AI voice.
xn_config_enable_ai_voice Description: Generate AI voice on button clicks.
xn_config_enable_deepseek_textgen Descri: AI optimizes voice text (Rec. use with AI Voice).
xn_config_custom_ai_api_key Description: Your API Key. Unlimited tokens/Custom models.
xn_config_custom_ai_model Description: Requires Custom Key. Empty = Default Model.
xn_config_enable_xianni_law Description: Unifies damage mechanics to use this mod only, solving conflicts. Restart required.
xn_config_enable_death_law Description: Unifies death interception mechanics to use this mod only. Restart required.
btn_xn_control_dashou_desc: Apply config behavior to all Thugs.
btn_xn_skin_tone_brush_desc: Change skin color of selected unit.
btn_xn_skin_tone_brush_description: Use brush to change skin color (Config in settings).
btn_xn_servant_brush_desc: 1st Click = Master, 2nd Click = Slave. 5 Year Contract. Fails if already has relation.
btn_xn_master_apprentice_brush_desc: Higher realm becomes Master. Fails if already has master or master is full.
btn_xn_possession_brush_desc: 1st Click = Soul, 2nd Click = Target. Ignores realm, but uses mod success rates.
btn_xn_reincarnation_brush_desc: Instantly kills unit and sends to reincarnation pool (100%).
btn_xn_main_character_brush_desc: Click to add MC status. Click again to remove. Only 1 MC allowed.
btn_xn_tournament_desc: God starts tournament (No Reward). Picks high power units for sea arena knockout.
btn_xn_newbie_guide_desc: Start the Xian Ni Mod Tutorial.
xn_guide_welcome: Welcome to Xian Ni Mod! Esc to Exit.
xn_guide_aura: Aura Label: Shows city aura value.
xn_guide_ruins: Place Ruins: Cultivators explore for items.
xn_guide_end: Explore more yourself! Check Mod Settings for details.
kingdom_trait_xn_fanjie_info: This is a Mortal World. Aura has no effect. Citizens cannot condense Spirit Roots.
btn_xn_feedback_desc: Rate and review the Xian Ni Mod.
